papers/phil-criteria.txt:
PHIL102 essay marking criteria (written by the instructor for this course)
Level 5 (21-25): A sustained argument that reaches a justified conclusion. Objections are stated at full strength and weighed, not merely listed.
Level 4 (16-20): A clear argument with a conclusion that follows. Objections are raised and answered, though the weighing is uneven.
Level 3 (11-15): Relevant arguments are stated but not weighed against each other. The conclusion is asserted more than it is earned.
Level 2 (6-10): Some relevant points with little connection between them. No real conclusion.
Level 1 (1-5): Fragments of relevant knowledge.
